neighbours.label: 'take' (or Chinese 带) in the sense of bringing someone or something along (take your kids, take your dog to school)
fire: Summer is a great time to take your kids to the seaside.
You will need to take your new puppy to training classes.
Don't forget to take an umbrella when you go out.
He always takes a small camera wherever he goes.
Every weekend we take the children to the park.
She took her grandmother to the doctor on Monday.
Remember to take your passport to the embassy.
他每天都带一个相机去公园。
quiet: Summer is a great time to visit the seaside with kids.

Don't forget to close the windows when you go out.
He always wears a small hat wherever he goes.
Every weekend we meet the children at the park.
